description: This file contains shell script functions for preparing, validating, synchronizing, and pushing pull request branches in a Git-based development workflow. It manages environment setup, branch resolution, verification, and automation steps for pull request lifecycle management.

methods.name: checkout_prep_branch
methods.description: Checks out the pull request preparation branch identified by resolving the branch name from the PR number.

methods.name: resolve_prep_branch_name
methods.description: Resolves and verifies the existence of the preparation branch for a given PR number.

methods.name: verify_prep_branch_matches_prepared_head
methods.description: Verifies that the local prep branch's head SHA matches the expected prepared head SHA, issuing guidance if discrepancies are found.

methods.name: prepare_init
methods.description: Initializes the preparation environment for a PR by fetching the PR, checking out the prep branch, and recording state in environment files.

methods.name: prepare_validate_commit
methods.description: Validates that the latest commit message in the prep branch does not contain PR number or contributor thanks metadata.

methods.name: prepare_push
methods.description: Pushes the prepared branch to the PR, verifying the head and updating prep metadata.

methods.name: prepare_sync_head
methods.description: Synchronizes the prep branch with the latest main branch, rebasing if necessary, and updates environment and status files.

methods.name: prepare_run
methods.description: Runs the full preparation workflow: init, gates, and push for a given PR.
